title: Sticky footer on short pages
when: The footer floats mid screen on short pages and the user wants it at the bottom of the window without covering content.
prompt:
Goal: A footer at the viewport bottom on short pages and after the content on long ones, without fixed positioning.
Steps:
1. Make the body or a wrapper a column: display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh; then min-height: 100dvh for phones with moving toolbars.
2. Give main flex: 1 0 auto so it absorbs free space; header and footer keep flex-shrink: 0.
3. Grid version if preferred: grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto on the wrapper.
4. Reset body margin to 0 and remove stray height: 100% rules that fight the layout.
5. Keep the footer in normal flow; position: fixed hides the last lines of content and breaks at high zoom.
Quality bar:
- No gap under the footer on a tall window.
- Long content pushes the footer down.
- Works at 200 percent zoom.
Pitfalls:
- height: 100vh instead of min-height, which clips long pages.
- Only 100vh on phones, where the toolbar hides the footer.
- A fixed footer covering form buttons.
Verify:
- [ ] Wrapper uses min-height with vh then dvh.
- [ ] main grows with flex or 1fr.
- [ ] Footer is not position: fixed.
- [ ] header, main and footer are direct children.
Output: Wrapper rules in style.css; header, main and footer as direct children of the wrapper.

examples.input: o rodape fica no meio da tela na pagina de contato
examples.output: body flex column with min-height 100dvh, main flex 1 0 auto, footer in normal flow
